messages:
Marta Chen: Heads-up — Zenith pushed a refresh to their marketplace SKUs this morning. They changed the reserved tiers and added a short-duration spot bucket. Need concrete inputs for cost-model runs.

Samir Patel: Can you paste the SKU matrix? rough tiers, regions, and any new pricing bands?

Marta Chen: Copying the snippet Zenith sent (sanitized):
```
sku,region,gpu_type,reserved_hourly_usd,reserved_term_days,spot_floor_usd,expected_preempt_pct,notes
zenith-a100-80-8,us-west-2,A100-80GB,24.50,365,0.85,3-7%,new small-commit tier
zenith-h100-4,eu-west-1,H100-80GB,28.00,90,1.10,8-12%,short-burst SKU
zenith-v100-16,us-east-1,V100-32GB,12.00,365,0.45,1-2%,legacy
```
(They included more regions; this is the excerpt they want modeled.)

Andrea Ruiz: Thanks. For our cost scenarios we need: per-SKU historical spot eviction rate, typical fill factor (how much baseline reserved actually used), and whether reserved hours are enforced per-month or flexible.

Marta Chen: Zenith said: "spot preemptions spike during vendor maintenance windows (monthly), and short-term spot pool availability can drop 50% for ~3-6 hours." No numbers on fill factor yet.

Jenna Li: For finance modeling we'll need: effective committed cost per token (or per-hour) under 3 scenarios: base (70% reserved fill), conservative (50% fill), optimistic (85% fill). Also the penalty/early-exit fee schedule for reserved term.

Kai Nakamura: Also ask Zenith for region-level lead times for pulling reserved vs ephemeral: if they require 14-day lead for reserved allocation that impacts autoscale assumptions. Any idea on that?

Marta Chen: They said "reserved allocations are provisioned within 72 hours after order confirmation in most regions; EU has occasional 10-day lag during capacity stress." I'll confirm.

Leo Park: From infra: we need expected GPU mix across commit windows (e.g., % of H100 vs A100 in reserved pool) and any planned firmware maintenance cadence that forces preemptions. That affects throughput/regression risk.

Samir Patel: Proposed deliverables from Zenith to close the loop: 1) CSV with sku x region x reserved_price x spot_floor x historical_preempt_rate (90d) 2) calendar of known maintenance windows for next 90 days 3) early-termination fee table 4) any marketplace listing fees or tiered discounts.

Marta Chen: I'll get Andrea to ask for that CSV and the maintenance calendar.

Andrea Ruiz: Sending a concise ask template to Zenith now, including a sample CSV header. Will CC Jenna for finance items.

partners-bot: Reminder — partner contract doc ID #ZEN-2025-07 requires marketplace fee disclosure before we publish listing (see link: https://contracts.internal/zen-2025-07).

Jenna Li: One more ask from finance: if they can provide a histogram of spot price over last 30 days (or hourly time series), we can better estimate volatility and tail risk for SLOs.

Marta Chen: Noted. Andrea — can you include histogram + 90d series in the ask?

Andrea Ruiz: Will do. Draft sent to Zenith; ETA for their reply is EOD Wed.

Kai Nakamura: Planning note for cost modelers: once we get the CSV, run three scenarios with these split assumptions: reserved mix 60/30/10 (base), 40/40/20 (conservative), 80/15/5 (optimistic). Also simulate 6-hr spot pool outages at 10% frequency.

Samir Patel: Sounds good. Jenna, when we get the numbers can you run an initial unit-economics delta vs our current Coreweave baseline?

Jenna Li: Yup — will do a delta report and flag any >5% uplift to per-token cost.

Leo Park: If Zenith's short-commit SKUs have higher preempt rates (>=8%), we should automatically route critical low-latency traffic away and use ephemeral for batch only. Ops will need routing rules.

Marta Chen: I'll coordinate with Eng to add routing guardrails once numbers arrive.

Andrea Ruiz: Update: Zenith replied with the full CSV link (internal): https://files.zenith/sku_export_2026_03_18.csv — downloading now.

Samir Patel: Great — post the key fields here when you can. Small Slack thread to collect them then we'll close this and turn into a modeling ticket.

Marta Chen: Thanks team. I'll follow up if Zenith provides anything else. :pray:
